context: Tests whether the agent executes the prompt-reviewer standard workflow on a deliberately flawed prompt: separates reasoning from the recorded report, cites the exact vague terms and missing requirements in the fixture, identifies the pattern, rates with a score, and provides concrete revised sections rather than generic advice.

checklist.name: Report file present
checklist.description: review-report.md exists in the working directory.

checklist.name: Quality score given
checklist.description: The report includes an overall quality assessment with a score out of 10 (e.g. 'Quality Score: 4/10').

checklist.name: Flags vague language
checklist.description: The report calls out the fixture's vague terms (e.g. 'natural English question', 'relevant', 'reasonable') as ambiguous, quoting or paraphrasing them.

checklist.name: Flags missing output format
checklist.description: The report identifies that the prompt never defines the SQL output format (no dialect, no query/explanation structure).

checklist.name: Flags missing examples
checklist.description: The report identifies that the prompt contains no examples despite being few-shot-suitable, or assesses the example situation explicitly.

checklist.name: Flags missing error handling
checklist.description: The report identifies the missing edge-case/error-handling path (invalid SQL request, unanswerable question).

checklist.name: Identifies and evaluates the pattern
checklist.description: The report names the prompt pattern in use and says whether it fits the task (not just praises it).

checklist.name: Prioritised by severity
checklist.description: Findings are ordered critical → major → minor (as the command prescribes), not a flat list.

checklist.name: Concrete revised sections
checklist.description: The report includes revised prompt text (critical sections) that fixes at least the output-format problem, not just advice like 'add examples'.

checklist.name: No imaginary features
checklist.description: The review does not credit or criticise features the fixture does not have; findings are anchored in the file.
